attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Pharmacy (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved courses; programs approved or offered by ACPE/CCAPP-accredited programs, ACPE-approved providers or another state board of pharmacy (no limit); max 5 hours per period from sponsors approved by non-pharmacy health care boards; postgraduate pharmacy courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies to applicants licensed for the whole 2-year period before the end of the license cycle.
rules.alternatives: Waiver request under MCL 333.16205 at least 30 days before the last regular Board meeting before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application certifies compliance; keep records 4 years. Random audit after each renewal period.

topics.who: 1 hour for each year of the license cycle (not one-time)
All licensees: one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.511)
Controlled substance licensees: opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135)

rules.notes: Two-year license; at least 10 of the 30 hours live/synchronous (in person or virtual; ACPE live counts); max 12 hours per 24 hours. CE earned in the 60-day grace period counts. Renewal fee $61.20 (+$165.40 controlled substance license).
rules.rule_quote: (e) Submit to the board satisfactory evidence that the applicant completed not less than 30 hours of continuing education approved by the board, under R 338.3043 and R 338.3044, during the license cycle before the application for renewal.
